title: Target training subsidies at skills employers need, and police provider quality
action: Direct training subsidies to courses that address identified skill shortages using labour market data, extend subsidies to short courses and micro-credentials that employers value, and pair open provider markets with strong quality checks.
why: Contestable funding widened choice, but subsidies spread across low-value courses and poor-quality providers waste money and leave students without useful skills.

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Target VET subsidies more effectively using labour market data and redirect course funding to address identified skills shortages.

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Extend Smart and Skilled program subsidies to target short courses and micro-credentials. Prioritise their funding towards skills which employers recognise and value.
